name: mytracer
description: A local-first Windows desktop shell for MyTracer.

scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:ai-contract: set "MYTRACER_AI_LIVE_CONTRACT=1" && vitest run --project integration tests/integration/ai-start-help-provider-contract.test.ts -t "live LiteLLM contract"
scripts.evidence:verify: node tools/evidence/capture-command.mjs --task unscoped --gate aggregate --output .tmp/evidence -- npm.cmd run verify
scripts.verify:release-tooling: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && vitest run --project unit tests/unit/ci-governance.test.ts tests/unit/release-provenance.test.ts tests/unit/release-tag-approval.test.ts && vitest run --project integration tests/integration/release-artifact-extraction.test.ts tests/integration/release-github-transport.test.ts tests/integration/release-pr-flow.test.ts tests/integration/release-publication.test.ts tests/integration/release-tag-flow.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
